SpaceX는 오늘 상승했고 나머지는 보합에서 하락했습니다. 한편으로는 $SPCX가 네오클라우드 비즈니스 모델이 얼마나 중요하고 수요가 얼마나 많은지 증명했습니다. 다른 한편으로는 $SPCX가 너무 좋아서 이제 사람들이 다른 네오클라우드가 쉽게 운영을 자금 조달할 수 있는 능력, Elon에 비해 그 회사들이 얼마나 빠리 컴퓨팅을 온라인으로 가져올 수 있는지, SpaceX 자신이 그 구축을 자금 조달하기 위해 얼마나 많은 부채/희석을 감수해야 하는지에 대해 의심하고 있으며, 이는 작은 플레이어들이 얼마나 많은 희석을 감수해야 하는지에 대한 질문을 제기합니다. text:
so $SPCX obviously blew the doors out with those earnings

especially if Elon gets anywhere close to his goal of bringing 20GW online by next year

the question now seems to be what this means for every other neocloud

SpaceX is up today, the rest are flat to red. 

On one hand, $SPCX proved how important the neocloud business model is and how much demand is out there.

On the other hand, $SPCX was so good that now people are doubting the ability for other neoclouds to easily finance their operations, how quickly those companies can bring compute online compared to Elon, and how much debt/dilution SpaceX themselves will have to take on to finance that buildout which then begs the question around how much dilution the smaller players will have to take on. SpaceX is also profitable whereas the others are years from profitability. 

My take is more that $SPCX has validated the entire concept of neoclouds which obviously have been under stress given the $CRWV bonds getting hit over the past two weeks, but the earnings were also so good that there might be more questions now about how well the others can execute.

The broader theme seemed to be legitimized from those earnings: the compute constraints exist and have not eased up in any meaningful way.
